msg.chroniclecaravans.overworld_only: Caravans only travel in the Overworld: this milestone is not on any route.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_placed: Milestone registered: %s. Caravans will now stop here.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_linked: Linked to %s (%s blocks away): caravans will travel between the two. Build a road and they will follow it.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_alone: No other milestone within %s blocks. Place a second one to open a trade route.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_incoming: A caravan is on its way, or already here.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_next: Next caravan expected in about %s min.
msg.chroniclecaravans.rep: Guild: %s · %s/%s xp to the next level
msg.chroniclecaravans.rep_disabled: Reputation is disabled on this server: every caravan shows its full stock.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_hint: Tip: use an Emerald Block on the milestone to hire a caravan right away, or a Relay Charter to upgrade it. Hold [W] over the milestone in your inventory for the guide.
msg.chroniclecaravans.hire_cooldown: The guild needs %s more min before sending another hired caravan.
msg.chroniclecaravans.hired: A caravan has been hired for %s. It will arrive shortly.
msg.chroniclecaravans.leaves: The %s moves on to distant lands.
msg.chroniclecaravans.ambush: Bandits are attacking the %s! Defend it!
msg.chroniclecaravans.saved: The %s is saved! Its master leaves you a reward.
msg.chroniclecaravans.own_stops: Your milestones: %s · caravans on the roads: %s
msg.chroniclecaravans.no_stops: No milestone has been placed yet.
msg.chroniclecaravans.no_room: No free ground to bring a caravan here.
msg.chroniclecaravans.no_caravan: No caravan to ambush (none loaded, or already under attack).
key.chroniclecaravans.guide: Open the Caravan Guide (hold over the milestone)
guide.chroniclecaravans.hold: Hold [%s] to open the Caravan Guide
guide.chroniclecaravans.title: Caravan Guide
guide.chroniclecaravans.controls: Drag: turn · Scroll: zoom · ← →: scenes · Space: pause
guide.chroniclecaravans.milestone.title: The Caravan Milestone
guide.chroniclecaravans.milestone.place: Place a Caravan Milestone where caravans should stop. Craft it from a lantern, an emerald and three stone bricks.
guide.chroniclecaravans.milestone.info: Right-click it to see when the next caravan is due, and your standing with the guilds. Broken, it gives back its lantern; with Silk Touch it keeps its schedule.
guide.chroniclecaravans.route.title: Trade Routes
guide.chroniclecaravans.route.link: Two milestones less than 320 blocks apart form a trade route: caravans travel from one to the other.
guide.chroniclecaravans.route.road: Build a road between them. Caravans stick to it, and walk 30% faster on it.
guide.chroniclecaravans.route.blocks: Dirt paths, gravel, cobblestone, stone bricks, planks and many more all count as road.
guide.chroniclecaravans.caravan.title: The Caravan
guide.chroniclecaravans.caravan.arrive: Here comes a caravan: its master leads a draft llama hitched to a covered wagon, with pack llamas trailing behind.
guide.chroniclecaravans.caravan.trade: It halts at the milestone for a few minutes. Right-click the master or the wagon: market, requests, services and guild.
guide.chroniclecaravans.caravan.regions: Each caravan comes from a far-away region and sells its goods. The colour of the canopy tells you which one.
guide.chroniclecaravans.ambush.title: Ambushes and the Guild
guide.chroniclecaravans.ambush.bandits: Bandits may ambush a caravan while you are nearby.
guide.chroniclecaravans.ambush.reward: Defeat them all: the master thanks you with emeralds and a gift from his homeland.
guide.chroniclecaravans.ambush.reputatio: Trading, hosting and protecting caravans earns guild experience. Each level unlocks rarer goods and a skill point, in three branches:
guide.chroniclecaravans.hire.title: Hiring a Caravan
guide.chroniclecaravans.hire.use: In a hurry? Use an Emerald Block on a milestone to hire a caravan right away.
guide.chroniclecaravans.hire.config: The guild then needs 10 minutes before taking another order. Every delay, chance and bonus can be changed in config/chroniclecaravans-common.toml.
guide.chroniclecaravans.villages.title: Villages
guide.chroniclecaravans.villages.bells: Caravans also travel between villages on their own: every village bell is a stop, no milestone needed.
guide.chroniclecaravans.villages.paths: Village paths are already roads: caravans follow them from one village to the next.
guide.chroniclecaravans.villages.network: Villages and milestones less than 320 blocks apart form one network of trade routes.
item.chroniclecaravans.milestone.kept: Schedule kept: next caravan in %s min
skill.chroniclecaravans.fair_seller.desc:
Caravans pay 25% more emeralds
for the goods they ask for.
skill.chroniclecaravans.hidden_stock.des:
Caravans show you their treasures:
enchanted books and rarities.
skill.chroniclecaravans.veteran_guards.d:
Your escorts have three guards
in iron armour instead of two.
skill.chroniclecaravans.bounty_hunter.de:
Every bandit you (or your guards)
defeat drops two emeralds.
skill.chroniclecaravans.warden.desc:
Escorts last twice as long
and cost less.
skill.chroniclecaravans.sworn_shield.des:
Caravans halting at your milestones
get a free guard while they stay.
skill.chroniclecaravans.foreman.desc:
Road crews cost 25% less
and work twice as fast.
skill.chroniclecaravans.paved_roads.desc:
Your crews pave in stone bricks
and put up lamp posts.
skill.chroniclecaravans.innkeeper.desc:
Caravans pay twice as much
for a night at your inns.
skill.chroniclecaravans.cartographer.des:
The atlas shows the caravans
and where they are heading.
gui.chroniclecaravans.state.lodging: Resting at an inn until morning
gui.chroniclecaravans.state.to_inn: Heading to an inn for the night
gui.chroniclecaravans.cannot_afford: You don't have what it takes
gui.chroniclecaravans.hint_market: Click: buy · Shift-click: buy all you can · 1-5: tabs
gui.chroniclecaravans.hint_requests: Click: sell · Shift-click: sell all you can
gui.chroniclecaravans.hint_services: Services are paid in emeralds from your inventory.
gui.chroniclecaravans.escort_desc: %s guards walk with this caravan for %s minutes and fight off monsters and bandits.
gui.chroniclecaravans.roads_not_here: Road crews are hired while the caravan is halted at a stop.
gui.chroniclecaravans.roads_none: Every route from here already has its road.
gui.chroniclecaravans.guild_help: Trade, host caravans, protect them and build roads to gain experience. Each level gives a skill point.
gui.chroniclecaravans.atlas.not_yours: Only its owner can rename it.
gui.chroniclecaravans.atlas.edit_help: Enter: save · Esc: cancel · empty: default name
gui.chroniclecaravans.atlas.no_caravans: Learn Cartographer to see the caravans.
gui.chroniclecaravans.atlas.help: Click a place or a route. Drag to move, scroll to zoom.
msg.chroniclecaravans.level_up: Guild level %s! You are now: %s. A new skill point awaits in the Guild tab of any caravan.
msg.chroniclecaravans.level_down: Your guild level has dropped to %s.
msg.chroniclecaravans.points: You have %s skill point(s) to spend: open any caravan, Guild tab.
msg.chroniclecaravans.outlaw: The caravan refuses to deal with an outlaw.
msg.chroniclecaravans.escort_over: The escort of the %s has ended.
msg.chroniclecaravans.road_hired: A road crew sets off towards %s (%s blocks).
msg.chroniclecaravans.road_done: The road between %s and %s is finished!
msg.chroniclecaravans.inn_placed: %s is open: at night, caravans nearby will stay here.
msg.chroniclecaravans.inn_no_bed: An inn needs a bed within %s blocks of its sign.
msg.chroniclecaravans.inn_hint: Caravans pay in the morning: put a chest or a barrel next to the sign.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_restored: This milestone kept its schedule: next caravan in about %s min.
msg.chroniclecaravans.no_stop: There is no caravan stop there.
msg.chroniclecaravans.not_yours: Only its owner can rename it.
guide.chroniclecaravans.inn.title: Inns
guide.chroniclecaravans.inn.sign: Put up an Inn Sign near a bed (a sign, a bed and an emerald make one).
guide.chroniclecaravans.inn.night: At nightfall, caravans within reach come to sleep at the inn, safe from bandits.
guide.chroniclecaravans.inn.morning: In the morning they restock their goods and pay the innkeeper, in a chest or barrel next to the sign.
guide.chroniclecaravans.services.title: Road Crews and Escorts
guide.chroniclecaravans.services.crew: In the Services tab, hire a road crew: it builds the road to the next stop for you.
guide.chroniclecaravans.services.escort: Hire an escort: guards walk with the caravan and fight off monsters and bandits.
gui.chroniclecaravans.roads_alone: No other stop within reach of this one: place a milestone less than 320 blocks away.
item.chroniclecaravans.loading_dock.tool:
Place it within 8 blocks of a milestone.
Named after a stop (anvil): ships its goods there.
Unnamed: receives the deliveries.
item.chroniclecaravans.trading_post.tool:
Trades on its own with the caravans halting nearby.
Hoppers fill and empty it, a comparator reads it,
a redstone signal pauses it.
gui.chroniclecaravans.state.camp_storm: Camping until the storm is over
gui.chroniclecaravans.state.camp_night: Camping for the night (no inn nearby)
gui.chroniclecaravans.hint_freight: A parcel leaves with the next caravan going its way. The [?] button explains it all.
gui.chroniclecaravans.hint_guild: One skill point per level · click a skill to learn it
gui.chroniclecaravans.guild_short: Trade with, host and protect the caravans to rise in the guild.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.off: Freight is disabled on this server.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.not_here: Parcels are handed over at a milestone, while the caravan halts there.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.none: No stop can be reached from here.
gui.chroniclecaravans.parcel.help: Close the crate to send it. The parcel waits at the milestone, leaves with the next caravan going its way and arrives in a chest or an unnamed loading dock against the destination milestone.
gui.chroniclecaravans.dock.address_help: Click and type the name of a stop: everything put in the dock is shipped there. Empty: the dock receives.
gui.chroniclecaravans.dock.fee_help: The emeralds in the dock pay the freight: 1, plus 1 per leg.
gui.chroniclecaravans.dock.status.no_fee: Not enough emeralds for the freight
gui.chroniclecaravans.post.orders.help: Samples of the goods to buy; the count is how many deals per caravan.
gui.chroniclecaravans.post.input.help: Goods the caravans ask for and emeralds to pay. Hoppers can fill it.
gui.chroniclecaravans.post.output.help: What the post earned. A hopper below empties it, a comparator reads it.
msg.chroniclecaravans.camp_storm: The %s makes camp to wait out the storm.
msg.chroniclecaravans.camp_night: No inn in sight: the %s makes camp for the night.
msg.chroniclecaravans.dock_no_stop: A loading dock must stand within %s blocks of a milestone.
msg.chroniclecaravans.parcel_sent: %s stacks sent to %s for %s emeralds (%s legs). The parcel waits at this milestone for a caravan going its way.
msg.chroniclecaravans.parcel_arrived: A parcel from %s has arrived at %s.
msg.chroniclecaravans.parcel_delivered: Your parcel has been delivered at %s.
guide.chroniclecaravans.weather.title: Weather and Camps
guide.chroniclecaravans.weather.storm: A thunderstorm! The caravan makes camp beside the road and lights a fire. In the rain it is also a quarter slower.
guide.chroniclecaravans.weather.night: At night, with no inn within reach, caravans camp too. An inn on their route is safer, and it pays you.
guide.chroniclecaravans.weather.onward: When the sky clears, they put out the fire and go on their way.
guide.chroniclecaravans.freight.title: Freight and Loading Docks
guide.chroniclecaravans.freight.dock: Name a Loading Dock after a stop with an anvil and place it near a milestone: what you put in is shipped there. Its emeralds pay the freight.
guide.chroniclecaravans.freight.carry: A halting caravan picks up the parcels. They go from stop to stop, over several legs if needed, until they arrive.
guide.chroniclecaravans.freight.receive: An unnamed dock receives the deliveries, and a hopper can empty it. Without a dock, parcels go into a chest beside the milestone.
guide.chroniclecaravans.freight.parcel: You can also send a parcel by hand from the Freight tab of a halted caravan.
guide.chroniclecaravans.automation.title: Redstone and Trading Posts
guide.chroniclecaravans.automation.call: A redstone pulse on a milestone calls a caravan, paid with an emerald block from a chest or barrel beside it.
guide.chroniclecaravans.automation.compa: A comparator reads the milestone: 15 while a caravan halts there, 1 to 7 while one is on its way.
guide.chroniclecaravans.automation.post: The Trading Post deals on its own with halted caravans: it sells what they ask for, then buys what its orders show. Hoppers fill and empty it.
msg.chroniclecaravans.relay_upgraded: %s is now a tier %s relay: %s caravan(s) at once with its hitching posts.
msg.chroniclecaravans.relay_max: This milestone is already at the highest tier.
msg.chroniclecaravans.relay_posts: Needs %s Hitching Post(s) within %s blocks first: one per caravan beyond the first.
msg.chroniclecaravans.relay_disabled: Relays are turned off on this server.
msg.chroniclecaravans.stop_relay: Relay tier %s: %s caravan(s) at once (%s hitching post(s) nearby).
msg.chroniclecaravans.post_stop: Hitching post for %s: %s post(s) around it, tier %s, %s caravan(s) at once.
msg.chroniclecaravans.post_inn: Hitching post for %s: caravans park their train here for the night.
msg.chroniclecaravans.post_alone: No milestone or inn within %s blocks: this post is not used yet.
msg.chroniclecaravans.asleep: The %s is asleep. Come back in the morning.
msg.chroniclecaravans.departs_cargo: The %s sets off for %s with %s parcel(s).
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.step.choos: Pick a destination and press Send.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.step.fill: Fill the crate and close it: the fee is paid then.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.step.wait: It waits at this milestone, then leaves with the next caravan going its way.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.step.arriv: It arrives in a chest or dock against the milestone. Right-click it to unpack.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.go_tip: Pack a parcel for %s: %s emeralds, paid when you close the crate.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.roof: One package is tied on the wagon's roof for each parcel on board.
gui.chroniclecaravans.freight.later: Waits for a caravan going its way.
item.chroniclecaravans.caravan_parcel.to:
Sent from the Freight tab of a halted caravan.
Right-click to unpack.
guide.chroniclecaravans.parcel.title: Sending a Parcel
guide.chroniclecaravans.parcel.send: At a halted caravan, open the Freight tab, pick a destination and fill the crate. The fee is paid in emeralds.
guide.chroniclecaravans.parcel.roof: The parcel waits at the milestone and leaves with the next caravan going its way. One package on the wagon's roof per parcel on board.
guide.chroniclecaravans.parcel.arrive: At its destination, the parcel goes into a chest (or an unnamed loading dock) against the milestone.
guide.chroniclecaravans.parcel.open: Right-click the parcel to unpack it.
